# Kundali Milan: Find Your Perfect Match

> A free Kundali Milan (Kundli matching) calculator. It scores marriage compatibility across the 8 Ashtakoot kootas (36 gunas) and can suggest the birth date and time of your perfect 36-guna match.

Live: https://match.vayuputra.co/

## Features

- Ashtakoot Milan score out of 36 with a breakdown of all 8 kootas: Varna, Vashya, Tara, Yoni, Graha Maitri, Gana, Bhakoot, and Nadi
- Checks for doshas such as Nadi, Bhakoot, and Manglik
- Perfect-match finder that suggests the birth date and time of a 36-guna match
- Download the result as a PDF or share it

## Useful for

- Kundli matching for marriage by birth details
- Understanding which kootas score well or poorly
- Finding what birth details would make a perfect astrological match

## About

- Free, no sign-up, nothing to install; runs entirely in your browser.
- Made by [Suraj Malpani](https://surajmalpani.github.io/), published by [Vayuputra](https://vayuputra.co/), which lists all its free tools.
